introduction.title: Who I am
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience developing, maintaining, and evolving enterprise applications. My core specialization is Java and Spring Boot, with experience across backend and full-stack development.

Throughout my career, I've worked on software for insurance, healthcare, agribusiness, and construction, contributing to new features, system integrations, performance improvements, and legacy application modernization.

My experience includes query optimization, production issue monitoring, and participation in an Oracle-to-MongoDB migration. I've also worked on healthcare scheduling software involving 5 million medical appointments and developed solutions that make complex business data more accessible to non-technical users.

items.skills: Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, REST APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
Docker, CI/CD, performance optimization, refactoring, and maintainable software design.

introduction.closing: I enjoy solving complex technical challenges, improving existing systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable software that supports real business needs.

Collaborate with the development team on application maintenance and technical improvements.
items.technologies: Java (8, 17, 21), Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, Oracle, MongoDB, Datadog, Jenkins, SonarQube, RabbitMQ, Checkmarx.
